entries.name: Certified Correctional Nurse
entries.definition: A certification for nurses who work in correctional facilities such as jails and prisons.

entries.name: Certified Culinary Administrator
entries.definition: An American Culinary Federation certification for chefs who hold administrative roles in running foodservice operations.

entries.name: Certified Diabetes Care and Education Specialist
entries.definition: A certification for health professionals who teach people to manage diabetes; it replaced the title Certified Diabetes Educator in 2020.

entries.name: Certified Dialysis Nurse
entries.definition: A certification from the Nephrology Nursing Certification Commission for nurses who care for dialysis patients.

entries.name: Certified Diversity Recruiter
entries.definition: A certification for recruiters who find and hire candidates from diverse backgrounds.

entries.name: Certified Documentation Integrity Practitioner
entries.definition: A certification from the American Health Information Management Association for people who review clinical documentation so that it accurately and completely reflects a patient's care and condition.

entries.name: Certified Energy Manager
entries.definition: A certification from the Association of Energy Engineers for professionals who manage energy use and efficiency in buildings and facilities.

entries.name: Certified First Responder
entries.definition: A credential for people trained to give emergency care at the scene before an ambulance crew arrives.

entries.name: Certified Flight Registered Nurse
entries.definition: A certification from the Board of Certification for Emergency Nursing for registered nurses who care for patients during air and ground transport.

entries.name: Certified Foot Care Nurse
entries.definition: A certification from the Wound, Ostomy and Continence Nursing Certification Board for nurses who assess and care for patients' feet.

entries.name: Certified Forensic Computer Examiner
entries.definition: A digital forensics certification from the International Association of Computer Investigative Specialists.

entries.name: Certified Forklift Operator
entries.definition: Proof that a worker has been trained and evaluated to operate forklifts safely, as US workplace-safety rules require an employer to certify.

entries.name: Certified Gastroenterology Registered Nurse
entries.definition: A certification from the American Board of Certification for Gastroenterology Nurses for registered nurses who work in gastroenterology and endoscopy.

entries.name: Certified Health Data Analyst
entries.definition: A certification from the American Health Information Management Association for professionals who acquire, analyse and report on health data.

entries.name: Certified Hemodialysis Technician
entries.definition: A certification for technicians who give hemodialysis treatments to patients with kidney failure.

entries.name: Certified Histotechnician
entries.definition: A certification from the ASCP Board of Certification for histotechnicians, who prepare thin tissue sections and stains for microscope examination.

entries.name: Certified Histotechnologist
entries.definition: A certification from the ASCP Board of Certification for histotechnologists, who do more advanced tissue-preparation and staining work and may supervise others.

entries.name: Certified Hospice and Palliative Care Administrator
entries.definition: A certification from the Hospice and Palliative Credentialing Center for administrators of hospice and palliative care programmes.

entries.name: Certified Hospice and Palliative Licensed Nurse
entries.definition: A certification from the Hospice and Palliative Credentialing Center for licensed practical and vocational nurses who care for hospice and palliative patients.

entries.name: Certified Hospice and Palliative Nurse
entries.definition: A certification from the Hospice and Palliative Credentialing Center for registered nurses who care for hospice and palliative patients.

entries.name: Certified Hospice and Palliative Nursing Assistant
entries.definition: A certification from the Hospice and Palliative Credentialing Center for nursing assistants who care for hospice and palliative patients.

entries.name: Certified in Logistics, Transportation and Distribution
entries.definition: A certification from the Association for Supply Chain Management for professionals who plan and manage logistics, transportation and distribution.
variants: Certified In Logistics, Transportation And Distribution (CLTD)

entries.name: Certified in Public Health
entries.definition: A certification from the National Board of Public Health Examiners for public health graduates who show broad knowledge of the field.

entries.name: Certified Industrial Hygienist
entries.definition: A professional certification for industrial hygienists, who anticipate, recognise, evaluate and control workplace health hazards.

entries.name: Certified Information Privacy Professional
entries.definition: A certification from the International Association of Privacy Professionals showing knowledge of privacy law and practice, offered for different regions.

entries.name: Certified Information Systems Auditor
entries.definition: A certification from ISACA for professionals who audit, control and assure the security of information systems.

entries.name: Certified Inpatient Coder
entries.definition: A medical coding certification from AAPC for coders who assign diagnosis and procedure codes to hospital inpatient records.

entries.name: Certified Insurance Counselor
entries.definition: A designation from the National Alliance for Insurance Education & Research for insurance professionals who complete courses in coverage and risk.

entries.name: Certified Insurance Service Representative
entries.definition: A designation from the National Alliance for Insurance Education & Research for customer-service staff in insurance agencies.

entries.name: Certified IRB Manager
entries.definition: A credential for managers of institutional review boards, the committees that review the ethics of research involving people.

entries.name: Certified Irrigation Designer
entries.definition: A certification from the Irrigation Association for designers of irrigation systems.

entries.name: Certified LabVIEW Developer
entries.definition: A certification from National Instruments showing that someone can design, build and debug well-structured LabVIEW applications.

entries.name: Certified Managed Care Nurse
entries.definition: A certification from the American Board of Managed Care Nursing for nurses who work in managed care.

entries.name: Certified Management Accountant
entries.definition: A certification from the Institute of Management Accountants for accountants skilled in financial planning, analysis and control.

entries.name: Certified Medical Assistant
entries.definition: A certification from the American Association of Medical Assistants for medical assistants who pass its examination.

entries.name: Certified Medical Billing and Coding Specialist
entries.definition: A certification for people who prepare healthcare claims and assign diagnosis and procedure codes.

entries.name: Certified Medical Laboratory Assistant
entries.definition: A certification for assistants who collect, prepare and process specimens in a medical laboratory.

entries.name: Certified Medical-Surgical Registered Nurse
entries.definition: A certification for registered nurses who work in medical-surgical nursing, awarded by the Medical-Surgical Nursing Certification Board.

entries.name: Certified Music Therapist
entries.definition: A credential showing that a music therapist has met professional certification requirements.

entries.name: Certified Nephrology Nurse
entries.definition: A certification for registered nurses who care for people with kidney disease, awarded by the Nephrology Nursing Certification Commission.
